glosses: first, first of all, in the first place, to begin with, initially
for now, for the time being

examples.en: At first, I was a little worried.
It can be confusing at first.

examples.text: Zunächst einmal werde ich das hier lesen.
examples.en: First of all, I'll read this.
At first, they didn't believe him.

examples.text: Zunächst einmal hätten Sie nicht herkommen sollen.
examples.en: You shouldn't have come here to begin with.
